name: Hand of Nature’s Might (Legendary Hunter Archetype)
body:
Many rangers supplement their abilities with formal martial schooling, using their natural abilities like a well-honed blade, with a well-honed blade.

Skills

The hand of nature’s might receives only 4 + their Intelligence modifier skill points per level. This modifies skills.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Hands of nature’s might are proficient with simple weapons, as well as light armor and bucklers. In addition, if this is the character’s first level in any class, they may select a martial tradition of their choice.

This modifies weapon and armor proficiencies.

Combat Training (Ex)

A hand of nature’s might is considered a Proficient practitioner, gaining spheres and talents as appropriate. They may choose Intelligence. Wisdom, or Charisma as their practitioner modifier.

This ability replaces the relentless stride, evasion, and perfect survivor.

Gifted Practitioner (Ex)

The hand of nature’s might may choose this option for their natural gift class feature. If they do, they chooses one of the following combat spheres:

Alchemy, Athletics, Beastmastery, Dual Wielding. Scout, Sniper, or Trap. They gain that sphere or one additional talent from that combat sphere as a bonus talent and an additional talent from that combat sphere every odd level thereafter.

This modifies natural gift but does not prevent the archetype from being compatible with other archetypes that modify this class feature.

Hand of Nature’s Might’s Talents

The hand of nature’s might adds the following to the list of talents they may choose their ranger talents from:

One Shot, One Kill (Ex)

(6th level)

(Predation)

As a standard action, the hand of nature’s might may attack their quarry with a damage bonus equal to their class level.

This stacks with any bonuses from their predation ability.

In addition, your quarry takes a -1 penalty to their attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, AC and Strength-based or Dexterity-based skill checks for 1 minute. This penalty can stack with itself up to a maximum of -5, and each time the hand of nature’s might increases the penalty, the duration of the total penalty is extended by another minute.

This is a special attack action.

Predatory Focus (Ex)

(Predation)

When the hand of nature’s might hits their quarry with an attack, they may expend their martial focus to do additional damage equal to twice their class level. Whenever the hand of nature’s might reduces their quarry to 0 hit points or less, confirms a critical hit against them, or causes them to become helpless, they regain their martial focus.

Hand of Nature’s Power

The magic of rangers is as varied as nature itself.

Casting

At 1st level, the hand of nature’s power may combine spheres and talents to create magical effects. They are considered a Low-Caster and use Wisdom as their casting ability modifier.

This replaces the spells class feature. If a class feature would add spells to the legendary ranger’s spell list, they do not receive that bonus but still may receive that class feature.

Spell Pool (Su)

The hand of nature’s power gains a small reservoir of energy they can call on to create truly wondrous effects, called a spell pool. This pool contains a number of spell points equal to their class level + their Wisdom modifier. This pool replenishes once per day after roughly 8 hours of rest.

Magic Talents: The hand of nature’s power gains one magic talent at every even level.

Gifted Caster (Ex)

The hand of nature’s power may choose this option for their natural gift class feature. If they do, they may choose one of the following magic spheres: Alteration. Conjuration, Divination, Enhancement, Life, Nature. or Weather. They gain that sphere or one additional talent from that sphere as a bonus talent and gain an additional talent from that sphere at 9th and 17th levels. In addition, they use their class level as their caster level with that sphere.

This stacks with other caster level sources normally.

This modifies natural gift but does not prevent the archetype from being compatible with other archetypes that modify this class feature.

Hand of Nature’s Power’s Talents

The hand of nature’s power adds the following to the list of talents they may choose their ranger talents from:

Powerful talent

The hand of nature’s might gains one magical talent of their choice. They may choose this talent multiple times.
